records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: By the way, ironically, these two people, both of them who brought this forward, take more than a million dollars from AIPAC.

verification.notes: Broad AIPAC-linked or conduit methodologies can place both members above one million dollars over their careers: current data aggregations list Gottheimer around 1.87 million and Lawler career conduit money around 1.05 million. But direct AIPAC PAC checks are far smaller, and independent expenditures or donor-conduit contributions are not money personally taken by a member. The wording collapses legally distinct categories.
